summary: Sync §2.2 rows in docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md for T069 and T109 with the modules each task actually delivered. T069 row now names `robinhood_lp.orchestrator` (T069 attempt-3 delivery) instead of the never-implemented `robinhood_lp.application.backtest_runs` prediction. T109 rows now name the module set T109 attempt-4 (commit c79e4c83) actually touched: `robinhood_lp.orchestrator` (application / orchestration), `robinhood_lp.backtest.engine` + `robinhood_lp.reports.{manifest,run_state,validation}` (backtest / research), with the protocol/domain `robinhood_lp.protocol.contracts` extension named in prose per §2.2's own rule. T110 row keeps the planned `robinhood_lp.application.historical_replay` path (T110 is PLANNED and the module does not yet exist); T111 row keeps the planned `robinhood_lp.reports.evidence_adapter` path (T111 is PLANNED; the file exists on disk from T109 attempt-1 but the §2.2 row names the planned path per the document's own convention). spec_revision bumped to v1-2026-09-21-section-2-2-module-attribution.
rationale: A0012's T069 plan prediction (`robinhood_lp.application.backtest_runs`) was never the path actually delivered: T069 attempt-3 (approved commit 4731b62) shipped `src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py`, registered in tools/check_imports/layer_map.py as `application / orchestration`. The same wrong prediction was repeated at T109's split (commit d697dd7) and survived through T109 attempts 1–3; T109 attempt-4 (commit c79e4c8) modified `orchestrator/__init__.py`, `backtest/engine.py`, `protocol/contracts.py`, `reports/{manifest,run_state,validation}.py`, none of which match the predicted `application.backtest_runs` path. §2.2's own disclaimer requires APPROVED rows to name modules that exist under src/robinhood_lp/. Reviewers for T109 attempts 2 and 4 already flagged this drift as a pre-existing repository-wide CI gap (tests/test_documentation_citations.py) and named this amendment as the fix. Running tools.check_citations now passes (previously failed: '§2.2 row for T069 references module robinhood_lp.application.backtest_runs which does not resolve under src/robinhood_lp/'). tools.workflow validate still passes. T110 and T111 are still PLANNED; §2.2 explicitly allows non-APPROVED rows to name planned paths that may not exist yet, so those rows stay as written. The §2.2 rule 'a row spanning two layers names only the modules of its own layer and describes the rest in prose' drove the choice to keep two T109 rows at the natural layer split and name the protocol/domain module in prose rather than introducing a third T109 row.
